cases.name: Renee Ladean Elmore Flaherty
cases.about:
Her Find-a-Grave said, "Renee was born in Longview, Washington but moved with her family to the Edgewood area when she was still a child. She and her siblings attended local schools their, graduating from Fife High.

After high school Renee became a truck driver. She married in 1988 and eventually moved to an area near Spokane. Renee and her husband seperated shortly after arriving in Spokane. Renee stayed while her husband moved to Alaska.

Renee worked at the local post office in Spokane, when she heard of an opening in Florida she moved her young family
there."
cases.narrative: He shot her once in the head.

cases.name: Suzanne L. Kjellenberg
cases.about: At the time of her death she was especially vulnerable because she was a drifter and had no known job.
cases.caseStatus: FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY ID'D HER; PENDING
cases.narrative: Landscapers found her remains along Interstate 10 in 9/1994. He told investigators how he met her at a truck stop near Tampa and they traveled together to a rest area. He parked next to a security guard and approached her as she slept in his truck’s bed.  He told investigators she began screaming and wouldn’t stop. He was not allowed to have unauthorized riders in his truck, and didn’t want to draw the security guard’s attention, so he put his fist against her neck and placed zip-ties around her throat. He dumped her body a short time later in Holt on the side of the I-10.
